arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Paul Smith argued Texas claims a right to punish. He stated this applies to unmarried couples. He emphasized the state's disapproval motive.
Texas counsel argued the state may enforce its penal code. They cited specific statutory provisions. They requested the Court uphold the law.
Chief Justice Rehnquist closed the session. He noted the case was submitted. No further questions were recorded.
